source_en: A CSV file, web page or PDF is a copy: the workbook keeps its own file.
uz_latn: CSV fayl, veb sahifa yoki PDF nusxa hisoblanadi: ish kitobi o`z faylini saqlab qoladi.

source_en: Insert checkboxes in the selected cells

uz_latn: Juft va toq sahifa kolontitullari boshqacha

source_en: Save the sheet as a PDF document that keeps its page layout.
uz_latn: Varaqni sahifa maketi saqlanadigan PDF hujjat sifatida saqlash.

source_en: Select destination and press Enter or choose Paste
uz_latn: Joyni tanlang va <<Enter>> tugmasini bosing yoki Qo`yishni tanlang

source_en: Calculation settings are saved with the workbook.
uz_latn: Hisoblash sozlamalari ish kitobi bilan birga saqlanadi.

source_en: Save the active sheet as comma-separated text.
uz_latn: Faol varaqni vergul bilan ajratilgan matn sifatida saqlash.

source_en: Lock the sheet structure so sheets can't be added, moved, renamed or deleted.
uz_latn: Varaq tuzilmasini qulflash: varaqlarni qo`shish, ko`chirish, nomini o`zgartirish yoki o`chirish mumkin bo`lmaydi.

source_en: Save the workbook under another name or in another folder.
uz_latn: Ish kitobini boshqa nom bilan yoki boshqa jildda saqlash.

source_en: Glide the selection outline to the cell you move to instead of jumping there
uz_latn: Tanlov ramkasi o`tilgan katakka sakramasdan silliq siljisin

source_en: Save .xlsx workbooks automatically after every change
uz_latn: .xlsx ish kitoblarini har bir o`zgarishdan keyin avtomatik saqlash

source_en: Sheet structure is locked: sheets can't be added, moved, renamed or deleted.
uz_latn: Varaqlar tuzilmasi qulflangan: varaqlarni qo`shish, ko`chirish, nomini o`zgartirish yoki o`chirish mumkin emas.

source_en: Save the workbook as a web page.
uz_latn: Ish kitobini veb sahifa sifatida saqlash.
